svg.title: Transfer utility and Educator-token savings across model pairs
svg.desc: Fixed-Window SSL gains over No Skill: Qwen main 7.8 percentage points, DeepSeek shared 3.1, Kimi shared 8.2. Issue-Guided vs Fixed-Window Educator-token savings are 61.7%, 63.8%, 77.4%. Qwen: 22 families and 155 held-out cases, 3 runs; DeepSeek and Kimi: 10 families and 77 held-out cases, 1 run each. Utility is averaged equally across task families.

g.aria-label: Family-macro utility. Qwen: 3 runs; DeepSeek / Kimi: 1 run each.
